Students should have completed at least one programming course (e.g., CSCI 1012 or equivalent). You won't type much code yourself in this course, since the agent does most of that, but you do need to be able to read code, follow what it's doing, and notice when something is wrong. That's what lets you direct an agent instead of blindly trusting it. Most of our code will be in Python and in web languages (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript). You don't need prior experience with either.
